articles.headline: Europa League game halted amid police clashes over fans' Palestine banner
articles.description: The game between Besiktas and Israel's Hapoel Beer-Sheva was halted when police clashed with fans of the Turkish club after they displayed a banner in support of Palestinians.

articles.headline: Milan rally to win at Olympiacos to kick-start UEL campaign
articles.description: AC Milan produced a second-half fightback from 2-0 down to beat Olympiacos 4-2 in Piraeus and kick-start their Europa League campaign.

articles.headline: 10-man Bournemouth beat Celta Vigo to top Europa League
articles.description: Bournemouth moved a step closer to automatic qualification for the Europa League round of 16 after coming from behind with 10 men to win 2-1 at Celta Vigo.

articles.headline: Christian Pulisic comes off bench to spark Milan win over Olympiacos
